content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Space FrontPage's PostSpace FrontPageMarch 31 at 1:52 PM · Shared with PublicThe last human lunar visit, Apollo 17, departed the Moon for Earth on December 14, 1972. This marked the final human presence on the lunar surface until the upcoming Artemis II mission. We encourage you to witness this significant event.
